title: Backups of goals and tasks: one command on the Mac and one button on the phone write a full restorable backup

requirements.text: genlock backup writes one archive holding every file in the project's .genlock/records folder
requirements.check: genlock backup, then count archive entries against the files in .genlock/records

requirements.text: Restoring that archive into an empty folder gives the same goal list and task list
requirements.check: compare genlock goal list and overview output before and after restore

requirements.text: The phone app has a backup button that saves the same archive to the phone
requirements.check: eye: TJ taps it on the Pixel and finds the file

evidence: node bin/genlock.mjs backup on this repo -> archive with 152 records/*.jsonl entries, live .genlock/records has 152; --all -> 856 records from 6 projects; tests/backup.mjs 4/4 pass

restored into empty git repo: goal list --all (9 lines) and list (104 lines) diff-identical; snapshot goals+tickets JSON byte-identical (overview itself only runs in the Assistant, so snapshot stands in); restore over existing records exits 4, --force saves them first; legacy ~/genlock-backups archive restores 148 records

text: Mac side done: lib/backup.mjs, genlock backup/restore in bin (repo copy; the PATH genlock is the app bundle's, so it arrives on next app build), tests/backup.mjs in npm test. Next: bridge 'backup' message sends genlock-all archive to the phone as a file; phone Back up button saves it to Downloads.

Mac + bridge + phone code done. genlock backup/restore (lib/backup.mjs, tests/backup.mjs 4/4); bridge 'backup' msg -> backup-file chunks (mobile/bridge/backup.mjs, test/backup.test.mjs 1/1); phone: Backup.kt, Link.askBackup, TopBar overflow 'Back up goals and tasks' -> Downloads/Genlock, compileDebugKotlin ok. Left: req 3 eye check needs a phone build + bridge restart; sprint session still editing Link.kt/MainActivity.kt so not installed yet.

what: The running bridge predates the backup message: the phone's Back up does nothing until the bridge restarts, and the PATH genlock (app bundle) lacks backup/restore until the app is rebuilt
verify: after restarting the bridge, tap Back up on the phone; bridge log shows 'backup to phone'
